as_told.title: Eric Taber told AARO of egg-shaped craft at Area 51

plain: The claim is that around 2023 a story came out about an egg-shaped craft, not built by humans, being recovered at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. Michels brings it up himself, recalling "the Daily Mail reporting about an egg-shaped UFO from Area 51 a year ago," without saying more about the article. A commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff traces the same story to a man named Eric Taber. He says Taber spoke to AARO, the Pentagon office that now collects and studies UFO reports. According to von Rennenkampff, Taber told them about "an egg-shaped craft being retrieved," which he believes was at Area 51. He gives no date. If true, it would mean the US holds at least one recovered craft of unknown origin.
